title: A stored basket changes shape under a new writer
story: A lets a basket line carry a gift note, so the Cart Durable Object now stores { productId: { qty, note } } instead of { productId: qty }, and reads baskets saved in the old shape too. B adds 'take one back out', written against the old shape: it reads lines[id] as a number and writes it back. Together, taking one egg out deletes the whole line from storage (an object compared with 1 is never greater). Each method names its own storage type, so the type-checker can't see the mismatch.

a.why: let a basket line carry a gift note

fact.sentence: A basket line can carry a gift note

b.why: let a shopper take one back out

fact.sentence: A shopper can take one of a product back out of the basket

resolution: takeOne() reads the basket through A's read() and changes the line's qty, so it works on both stored shapes.
